causing it to radiate visible light.

original_en:
Sealstones are residue formed from
the hardened "sap" that drips from
Yggdrasil's roots.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 〓グドラシルのカスって事か…
original_en: You mean like amber from Yggdrasil...

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: カスとはいえ封印石は安置された場に力を与えます
original_en:
Call it amber if you will. A sealstone
exerts power over the area it is placed.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: この場所と 周〓一〓に縁のある敵の動きを〓えてくれるでしょう
original_en:
It suppresses the actions of enemies
bound to this location and the
surrounding areas.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: じゃあ持って歩けばお守りになるのか？
original_en:
Then, how about if we take it with us
for protection?

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 〓えられるのは敵ばかりではありません持つ者も何らかの影〓を受けるでしょう
original_en:
Sealstones don't just affect enemies.
The bearer may also be subject to some change.

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: 仮にルーファス殿が持つのなら行動を共にする我々にも です
original_en:
If you were to carry it, Sir Rufus, then
the effects would be felt by all of us.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …どんな影〓だよ？

speaker: Lezard
original_jp: さあ そればかりは…やってみなければわかりません
original_en:
I'm afraid that's just it...
One cannot know until one tries.

speaker: Dylan
original_jp: ドラゴンオーブを守護する一族はこの封印石の力を熟知していたはずだ
original_en:
The tribe that guarded the Dragon Orb had
to be very familiar with these sealstones.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: その知恵でもって ドラゴンオーブを安置する神殿を〓てたってのか…
original_en:
So, they used that knowledge in building
palaces to keep the Dragon Orb safe...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: やっぱり持ってって損はなさそうだな
original_en:
Sounds like it wouldn't hurt to take it
with us.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: 途中で捨てる事もできなければ永遠に持ち続ける事も不可能 <PART> ――
original_en:
Sealstones cannot be disposed of, nor
can they be held onto forever.

speaker: Silmeria
original_jp: いずれ大地を支える力に〓し潰される事になるでしょうね

power will crush the holder.

original_jp: …ええ
